Event EVT-DEMO-001 has no files in the compliance store. Open the source CES task drawer to add evidence with task context. Upload blocked until a CES task context is selected. Audit log — event EVT-DEMO-001 (0 entries) No audit entries yet for this event. What is "evidence"? Any file that proves a regulated activity happened — QAPI minutes, signed forms, competency checklists, training rosters, OASIS lock confirmations. Why the triplet? Every artifact is bound to a policy_id, workflow_id, and event_id. A surveyor can pull a single event packet and reconstruct the entire chain of custody. Audit log Append-only entries record who initiated each upload, every status transition, and every download URL we mint. Nothing in this view is editable. What to do next Pick the event you're documenting (top-left). Open the source CES task drawer and upload from its evidence requirement. Verify the new row appears with status EVIDENCE_LOCKED. Use Download to obtain a short-lived presigned URL. API: https://rtllnugat0.execute-api.us-west-1.amazonaws.com GUIDED UAT 5/6 operational checkpoints

INSTRUCTIONS The assigned workforce member shall complete this form within 30 calendar days of policy issuance or revision. Submitted acknowledgments are retained in the personnel file for seven (7) years. A monthly exception report is generated for any workforce member with outstanding acknowledgments. I agree to comply with this policy, related procedures, and all referenced regulations at all times during my engagement with Care Indeed Home Health Care, Inc. I understand that failure to comply may result in corrective or disciplinary action up to and including termination.
